title: Top 3 Salaries Per Department
description: A high earner in a department is an employee who has a salary in the top 3 unique salaries for that department. Find all high earners. Return department_name, employee_name, and salary, ordered by department_name ascending, salary descending, and employee_name ascending.
solutionQuery: WITH Ranked AS (SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.salary, d.department_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS rnk FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id) SELECT department_name, employee_name, salary FROM Ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY department_name ASC, salary DESC, employee_name ASC;
explanation: Compute DENSE_RANK() partitioned by department_id and ordered by salary descending. Filter where rnk <= 3.
